_doc: ADR 0026 v2 / M27 — real third-party Sinatra gem vendored 1:1 from rubygems. `sinatra-jsonp-0.5.0` (Britt Crawford, MIT) vendored verbatim under `vendor/sinatra/jsonp.rb` — the exact gem source file. Runs unmodified on both runtimes: rubyrs satisfies `require 'multi_json'` via a tiny shim that wraps `JSON.generate` (the canonical _json_native-accelerated path); CRuby satisfies it via the installed `multi_json` gem. Both runtimes `require 'sinatra/jsonp'` through `$LOAD_PATH.unshift File.expand_path('vendor', __dir__)` so the vendored copy loads ahead of any rubygems-resolved gem. Validates: a real published gem's authoring shape (Sinatra.helpers + content_type :symbol + settings.respond_to? + params.delete + alias) loads + runs byte-identical on the vendored micro-Sinatra and on the real Sinatra gem. Closes the loop on M27's third-party-plugins claim with an actual gem rather than a fixture-local approximation.
name: sinatra_jsonp_smoke
